title: Bold Type Minimal / 字体主导极简
summary: Graphic typography, simple geometric structure, a strict palette and one carefully placed image.

dna.principle: Let a short piece of precise typography do the heavy lifting while one image or shape establishes context.

composition.focal_strategy: Headline and one image compete productively but not equally
text_zones: Bottom corner details and optional CTA
composition.negative_space: Wide uncluttered margins and deliberately empty module
composition.depth: Flat geometric planes with a single cropped photo layer

visual.contrast: Strong light/dark block contrast with one bright accent
visual.texture: Almost none; allow subtle paper grain only
visual.image_treatment: Clean crop or discrete cutout; no excess AI effects

typography.headline_style: Oversized heavy sans, bold 1–3 line statements
typography.hierarchy: Headline first, image second, information third

copywriting.headline_guideline: Use a short concrete phrase; break lines intentionally
copywriting.cta_guideline: One simple action if needed; never fabricate urgency

must: Use only one dominant accent color
Keep precise words out of generative image artifacts
Preserve product/subject features in the hero crop
avoid: More than two unrelated type personalities
adaptation: If headline is long, reduce size and add line breaks while preserving margins
If the input image is visually busy, use a clean frame and flat background
If intended for mobile, make the primary title readable at thumbnail scale

provenance.notes: Original illustrative starter genome; not learned from a third-party poster.
